resilience_accessibility.rationale: The residual points are supported by explicit loading, empty, network-error, validation, and submission-status paths, plus semantic labels/focus treatment and browser error-free evidence. evidence: supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:4-18 — leaderboard constraints, index, and RLS enablement.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:20-41 — SELECT/INSERT policies with WITH CHECK validation, public privilege revocation, and only SELECT/INSERT grants for anon/authenticated roles.
src/leaderboard.ts:12-31,58-75 and .env.example:1-2 — client configuration uses only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; no privileged browser credential path is present.
results/evidence/monolith_grok_4_5_high_fast_cursor/automated.json:147-205,273-293 — live Supabase GET requests returned 200, insert returned 201, and reload persistence was observed.
